method: Built-in image_gen for direction art, background plate and peeking foregrounds; deterministic source-preserving composition for PNG sheets and GIF encoding.

prompts.pixel_turnaround: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: precise blue bulb mascot pixel character turnaround PNG sheet. Image 1 is the ONLY exact design and pixel palette identity. Keep its silhouette proportions, screw socket, cream oval face, straight eyebrows, small eyes, w mouth, orange cheeks, teal shoes, cream hands. Preserve the blue outer bulb and bright cyan CENTER stepped gradient bands, white highlight streaks. Preserve the NEW two vertical wires ending in four coil loops filament, NOT a pi symbol. Create seven views arranged in 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows: row1 FRONT, RIGHT PROFILE, LEFT PROFILE, FRONT THREE-QUARTER; row2 BACK, TOP VIEW, FACE CLOSEUP, leave final cell empty transparent. No text or labels anywhere. 1536x1024 canvas, equal384x512 cells. Full sprites uncropped centered on same baseline with generous padding. Match source's pixel medium strictly: uniform square pixels, nearest-neighbor look, no antialias, no blur, no smoothing. Maintain same proportions across views, no squashing bulb. Filament anchored inside rigid bulb, coherent side perspective; no filament on rear view. Transparent background, tiny stepped grey oval ground shadow for full body views. Source uses heavy outline around face, do NOT add heavy outline around entire bulb not present in reference. No added light rays, no background. This is a production sheet matching an existing character, not a redesign.
prompts.basic_turnaround: Precise identity-preserving character turnaround, smooth BASIC NON-PIXEL version. The single supplied blue character is the exact identity, do not redesign. Keep its bulb silhouette and ratios, silver socket, small cream oval face, straight horizontal eyebrows, black round eyes, w mouth, orange cheek ovals, teal shoes and cream round hands. Preserve blue outer shell and BRIGHT CYAN CENTER gradient, white highlights, two hanging wires ending in FOUR coil loops filament. No pi/trident symbol. Create seven views in EXACT 4 columns x 2 equal rows: FRONT, RIGHT PROFILE, LEFT PROFILE, FRONT THREE-QUARTER; BACK, TOP VIEW, FACE CLOSEUP, final cell empty. 1536x1024 canvas, equal384x512 cells. Smooth clean vector-like curves and soft interior color gradients exactly like reference, no pixelation. Full sprites fit inside each cell with generous margins. NO TEXT NO GRIDLINES NO PANEL BORDERS. Actually TRANSPARENT alpha background, not white or checkerboard. No shadows or halos outside characters. Preserve original outline placement, don't add thick black outlines around bulb/socket where absent. Same consistent character scale in all full-body views. Filament must be fixed inside bulb, no filament on rear. This is a reusable production asset sheet.
prompts.sky_cleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this EXACT 3840x2160 wallpaper. Remove ALL SIX dinosaur characters completely, including the giant central bottom green dinosaur and the five edge dinosaurs. Remove ALL palm trees, palm trunks and palm leaves. Seamlessly reconstruct only the existing clear blue sky and original white clouds behind the removed objects. Preserve the original 16:9 composition, existing blue sky colors and sky gradient, original white cloud masses at lower left and lower right edges, original small bright sun around left-of-center/lower-left. No characters, no silhouettes, no eyes, no green shapes, no vegetation. Output a clean empty background plate, smooth original illustration sky, 3840x2160 pixels. No text or labels. Opaque background. Do not add extra objects or change the sky to a new scene.
prompts.pixel_peeking: Use case: compositing / identity-preserve. Create ONLY a transparent foreground character layer for a 3840x2160 wallpaper. Input1 is strictly CAMERA COMPOSITION reference, input2 contains the EXACT FIVE bulb mascot designs (left-to-right WHITE RED GREEN BLUE YELLOW) to preserve. Replace the five EDGE dinosaurs of input1 with these five bulbs; OMIT the giant bottom-center green dinosaur entirely. Exact placements: WHITE very large entering from upper left, RED upside/inward peeking from upper center, YELLOW tilted in from upper right, BLUE entering from bottom left, GREEN entering from bottom right. Exactly FIVE bulbs, each color once. Keep the original edge positions, inward rotations, giant close-up scale and cropping. Camera lies on ground looking straight up; characters lean over and LOOK DOWN at camera. This must look like the original dramatic low-angle group peeking in, NOT a lineup of full-body front sprites. Faces can be cut off: only EYES/upper faces need be visible just like input1. Mouths, lower faces, feet and screw caps can be outside the frame; DO NOT shrink figures to fit their entire faces. Keep a very large completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT central opening, with no sixth figure at bottom-center. No sky, clouds, sun, palms, plants, dinosaurs, scene background, text or gridlines: actual alpha=0 everywhere except the five characters. Preserve exact smooth round bulb silhouettes, silver screw sockets where visible, the TWO WIRES WITH COIL-LOOP filament, warm cream faces, tiny black eyes, orange cheeks, blue/red/green straight brows, yellow angled brows, white worried brows and UNLIT GREY filament. Preserve the bright CENTER color bands and highlights of input2. Uniform crisp PIXEL ART, no blur, no antialias or smooth gradients: stepped color bands and square dots. All character parts rendered in matching 8-bit pixel style. Do not stretch or squash bulbs. Output one 16:9 transparent PNG foreground plate, 3840x2160, not a sprite grid.
prompts.basic_peeking: Use case: compositing / identity-preserve. Produce a SMOOTH BASIC NON-PIXEL transparent character-only foreground layer for a 3840x2160 wallpaper. Image1 is camera/composition reference only. Image2 is the EXACT approved bulb mascot identity palette and proportions (left-to-right WHITE RED GREEN BLUE YELLOW). Image3 is the approved five-color peeking layout in pixel medium: translate its positions/cropping/inward angles faithfully into the smooth style of image2. Exactly FIVE characters: WHITE cropped huge in upper-left, RED cropped hanging in upper-center, YELLOW tilted inward in upper-right, BLUE cropped at bottom-left, GREEN cropped at bottom-right. Keep the entire large central opening TRANSPARENT and empty. NO sixth bottom-center character. Camera on ground looking straight up, characters leaning over LOOKING DOWN into camera. Keep dramatic extreme close-ups with head/face cut off at frame edges; only eyes/upper face need to show, mouth/feet/socket may lie outside frame. Do not shrink to fit complete faces. Preserve original bulb silhouettes without squashing, soft blue/red/green/yellow outer colors with bright CENTER gradient, white bulb pale lavender with grey UNLIT coil, exact small cream face/black eyes/brows and orange cheeks. TWO orange cheek patches per face only, NO ears, NO horns, NO extra orange patches near top of face. Preserve TWO WIRES ending in FOUR LOOP COIL filament. Smooth clean illustration curves, soft interior gradients and highlights like image2, no pixel blocks, no 3D photorealism. Actual transparent alpha background: NO sky, no clouds, no palms, no dinosaurs, no background colors or halos, no text or grid. Output one 16:9 transparent PNG layer at 3840x2160.

postprocessing: Original front body and filament remain rigid. Limbs and eyes are separate layers. Generated blue directional art is recolored for other bulb colors. Normal/glow and two expressions are separate outputs. PNGs precede backgrounds, then pixel GIFs at 180ms. Original reference files are preserved.
